WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT s.entrystat,
         AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambient_temp,
         AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_images
  FROM scanenvironment AS e
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.entrystat
)
SELECT entrystat,
       avg_ambient_temp,
       avg_images,
       avg_images - AVG(avg_images) OVER () AS image_avg_minus_status_mean
FROM status_averages;
